WITH invoiced AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM invoiced
),
above AS (
  SELECT i.order_count, s.avg_count
  FROM invoiced i CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE i.order_count > s.avg_count
)
SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_above_figure,
       AVG(order_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess
FROM above;
